  FROM subscriptions AS s
  WHERE s.account_id = t.account_id

) AS latest_subscription ON TRUE

  SELECT 1
  FROM ticket_events AS e

);

    FROM risk_assessments
) AS latest
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY risk_score DESC, customer_id
LIMIT 3
